learning_objective: 🎯 Let's explore the magical friendship between art and music by designing, building, and decorating our very own colorful instruments!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Artists don't just make things to look at; they make things to listen to! We can build awesome musical instruments using boxes, rubber bands, and beads.
A great instrument sounds good and looks beautiful. We can paint bright patterns, glue shiny sequins, and tie colorful ribbons to make our instruments pop!
When we wear beautiful masks we created, play the instruments we built, and sing a song together, we are blending visual art with the performing arts!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Build a Bottle Shaker!
fun_activity.instructions: Fill an empty plastic water bottle with a handful of dry beans or rice. Wrap the outside with colored paper and stickers, then shake it to the beat of your favorite song!

quick_recap: ⭐ We can recycle everyday objects to craft amazing musical instruments.
⭐ Adding colorful paints and patterns makes our instruments look super exciting.
⭐ Combining singing, playing, and crafting makes art incredibly fun.
